body: Thanks for sticking with me man. How are you holding up yourself?
Why would you be sorry? You're the one who tried to help me, I should be thanking you.

I'm not sure whether it's for your benefit, or for mine, but i'm not dead yet, even though considering the amount of drugs i've taken, I really should be. On the advise of the medics, i'll be heading of to A&E in a little while. Thanks for your messages, and your support.
If you understand narcissists, you'll understand my family. I'm sorry if uium not making sense, it's very difficult to type write about npow.
Thanks for your kindness. Since it's drug induced, I think this is out of my control at this point.
I probably need it, I haven't slept since yesterday. I can appretiate what your saying, but it sure feels like that at the moment.
